{{Quote|Vinefish fresh off the grill.|A vendor, to Zeerid Korr|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
'''Vinefish''' were a type of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] creature. Vinefish were grilled by [[Free-trader|vendors]] and sold as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] near [[Yinta Lake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] that the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] was on his way to meet his [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], [[Arra Yooms]],<ref name="Deceived" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with [[Zeerid Korr]]'s visit to [[Vulta]], occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> One such [[Unidentified vendor|vendor]] attempted to sell Korr some freshly grilled vinefish, but Korr did not buy any.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vinefish were mentioned in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
